description: This file defines the DeleteThemeCommand class, which handles the deletion of themes in the Superset application, including validation, dissociation of dashboards, and error handling.

classes.name: DeleteThemeCommand
classes.description: A command class to delete themes, ensuring they are not system themes or in use, and dissociating dashboards before deletion.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with a list of theme IDs to delete.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the deletion process, including validation and dissociation of dashboards.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that themes exist and are eligible for deletion, and gathers dashboard usage info.

methods.name: _dissociate_dashboards
methods.description: Removes associations between dashboards and themes before deletion.

methods.name: _get_dashboard_usage
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards that are using the themes to be deleted.

methods.name: get_dashboard_usage
methods.description: Public method to access dashboard usage information.
